controls: Normal field scene. ScreenTouch + Drag. 120Hz physics, traveling against fixed world. Rendering captured separately through gameplay camera.
notes: Contact means the lower material surface of either boot. Ground is actual mesh top at Y=0, collision box top Y=0, shader has no height displacement. >1 cm is a measurement convention, not a reference-derived threshold. Each foot separately tracked. A and B recordings do not expose a ground calibration in centimetres.
